violated_contract: Transcript post-processing may add what a provider left out, but it must not discard what the provider returned. Pre-recorded segment text was built with str.capitalize(), added in 2024 when fal WhisperX was the only pre-recorded provider. Parakeet, Modulate and Deepgram return cased, punctuated text, and capitalize() lowercased every name, acronym, "I" and later sentence start in each merged segment. That degraded offline-sync, voice-note and batch transcripts, and broke case-sensitive consumers such as sync's text-based speaker naming.
canonical_prevention: Normalize provider text only with transforms that leave already-cased input unchanged (capitalize the first character and keep the rest as returned). Pin cased, multi-sentence provider output through the real postprocess_words path together with a case-sensitive downstream consumer.
